POSP.description: Calculate Soil Spring Property Kh (POSP). Drives Kh calculation for one or more existing soil spring properties (POSP) identified by ID; each entry selects the Vs evaluation method and layer configuration used to compute the horizontal subgrade reaction coefficient.

CALC_KH.description: Calculation Coeff. List of Kh calculation requests, one per target POSP property.

ID.description: Key (ID) of an existing POSP soil spring property to recalculate Kh for.

METHOD.description: Vs evaluation method (case-insensitive). VS_LV: use Vs by level for each soil layer. VS_AVG: use averaged Vs.

LAYERS.description: Layer configuration for averaging (case-insensitive). SINGLE: single layer. DOUBLE: two layers split at SPLIT_LV.

SPLIT_LV.description: [LAYERS=DOUBLE] Top Level of 2nd Layer. Level at which the ground is split into the second layer; only consumed when LAYERS is DOUBLE.
